notes: Two waws stand before the last two clauses but the ASV writes one connective; 'and yet' goes to the waw whose clause it introduces and the earlier waw is unrepresented (rule 42's counting, rules 22, 55).
'shall he break' has no interrogative morpheme, so its auxiliary and subject pronoun are the verb's own (rule 17), while each written הֲ earlier takes one fronted auxiliary.
